title: Affine pushforward of a quasi-coherent K-injective resolution
statement: Let X and Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and f : X → Y an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let F and J be unbounded integer-indexed complexes of structure-sheaf modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with every term of F quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and J K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. If s : F → J is a quasi-isomorphism, then termwise pushforward f_*(s) [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] is a quasi-isomorphism. No boundedness or quasi-coherence of the terms of J is assumed.

source.place: cohomology.tex, Tag 08C2, singleton-cover affine case and unbounded proof; perfect.tex, lemma-affine-morphism-equivalence, affine cohomology calculation.

proof.text: For every affine open V of Y, its inverse image is affine. Apply affineOpenSections_resolution_quasiIso on that inverse image to s. Forget the global scalar action: the resulting map is definitionally the additive-group section map of f_*(s) on V.

Take homology of the underlying additive presheaf complex map. Exact evaluation and the preceding sectionwise quasi-isomorphisms make its components invertible on all affine opens. The basis germ formulas prove that the induced stalk maps are bijective: injectivity is TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis, and surjectivity lifts a basis germ using exists_mem_germ_eq_of_isBasis and componentwise surjectivity.

Filtered colimits of abelian groups are exact, so the presheaf stalk functor preserves homology. The preceding stalk isomorphisms therefore make the stalk complex map a quasi-isomorphism. Exactness of module stalks identifies these with stalks of the sheaf homology map. The stalkwise bijectivity criterion isIso_of_bijective_stalkLinearMap makes the sheaf homology map invertible in every degree, proving the assertion.

theorem affinePushforward_resolution_quasiIso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    (F J : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    [J.IsKInjective] (s : F ⟶ J) [QuasiIso s] :
    QuasiIso (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map s)
